text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Zimbabwean capital Harare's major hospitals are now enforcing a zoning system for direct patient admissions to reduce the workload on staff and scores of patients were turned away at the weekend.
- Three people were killed and 45 others injured in 149 road accidents reported in Harare between Christmas Eve and Sunday morning, police said.
